metadata.title: Jellyfin Movie Purger
metadata.description: Identify and safely delete fully viewed movies across Jellyfin and Radarr

header.title: Jellyfin Movie Purger
header.subtitle: Identify and safely delete fully viewed movies across Jellyfin and Radarr

warning.label: Caution:
warning.message: This tool permanently removes matched movies from disk through Radarr and Jellyfin. Always review your selection before purging.

scan.title: Library Diagnostics Control
scan.description: Scans Jellyfin and Radarr for fully viewed movies not watched in the last {months} months.
scan.emptyHint: Run a scan or adjust the threshold in Server Connections.

config.jellyfinSubtitle: Required to scan watch history and delete items
config.keepExistingKey: Leave blank to keep the existing key. Current: {key}
config.radarrSubtitle: Used to cross-reference and delete movie files
config.keepExistingRadarrKey: Current key: {key}. Leave blank to keep existing.
config.thresholdHint: Only suggests deletion of movies last watched more than {months} months ago.

scheduler.title: 3. Scheduled Cleanup
scheduler.subtitle: Automatically scan and purge eligible movies on a recurring schedule
scheduler.warning: When enabled, every scheduled run deletes all movies returned by the scan (above the watch cut-off threshold) from Jellyfin and Radarr when matched. No manual review step.
scheduler.serverTimeNote: Runs only while this app process is running (next dev / next start). Schedule uses the server's local time zone.

logs.title: Console Runtime Log
logs.empty: > Log empty. Perform a scan or purge to generate operational output.
